verdict.rationale: Browser Use's Cloud API exposes runs, sessions, structured output, observability events, browser stealth/CAPTCHA handling, profiles, and 2FA flows that mirror UI capabilities, and docs explicitly frame the API as the way to automate what the UI shows. However, a live preview/human-checkpoint fallback for CAPTCHAs and 2FA is UI-only (no API equivalent for manual intervention), and no OpenAPI spec was found (404s across all candidate paths), suggesting the API surface isn't fully self-documented or verifiably complete relative to the UI. missing for 10: OpenAPI/spec confirming full API-UI parity, an API-only path for human-in-the-loop CAPTCHA/2FA steps that currently require the live preview UI, independent hands-on confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
